chunks: Each soul will be recompensed that Day for what it had earned. There will be no depriving on that Day. Surely God is swift at reckoning.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about justice and reckoning on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ghafir underscores the precision of divine retribution, affirming that God’s swift accounting leaves no room for error or injustice. It reinforces the concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice), where every individual bears the full weight of their own actions, a principle often linked to the broader theological discourse on the Day of Resurrection.
